text:
talia: Quick company-wide note from runtime: landed the hybrid-batcher change to canary. Short summary: p50 ~10% lower, p95 ~17% lower, estimated infra token cost reduction ~24% for mixed workloads. :tada:

zhou: Congrats! what is hybrid-batcher in one line?

talia: It merges time-based microbatching for short requests with size-aware batching for medium requests, plus a small RPC coalescer to cut duplicate KV reads. Aims to reduce tails without hurting single-request latency.

alan: Canary numbers?

perf-bot: Canary report (hybrid-canary-2027-04-05): requests=130,450, mix chat/completion 55/45, median seq 52, p50 47ms -> 42ms, p95 238ms -> 198ms, error rate unchanged 0.028% -> 0.028%. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/perf/hybrid-canary-2027-04-05

zhou: Any regressions observed?

talia: No customer-facing regressions. We saw modest increase in coordinator CPU (~6%) under synthetic microbursts, added a soft concurrency cap and a graceful degrade to previous batching mode if host memory pressure > 80%.

alan: Rollout plan?

talia: Progressive: canary -> 4% -> 20% (overnight) -> 60% (24h) -> 100% (48h). Auto-rollback if p95 increases >5% or error rate delta >0.15%.

ops-bot: Estimated monthly infra token spend savings if fleet-wide: 22-26% for mid-tier and convo-heavy tenants. Logged under COST-2027-04-HYBRID.

zhou: Please add a short blurb for the next all-hands and a 1-paragraph note for the model-onboarding checklist (batching mode implications).

talia: Will draft slides and add config snippet to docs. Config snippet used in canary:

```
batcher:
  mode: hybrid
  microbatch_timeout_ms: 10
  size_threshold_tokens: 2048
  rpc_coalesce_window_ms: 5
  max_coalesce_requests: 12
```

perf-bot: Rollout started at 1805000100; current rollout 4%. Monitoring enabled.

alan: Nice work team. Can we schedule a short retro after the 20% step to capture tuning learnings?

talia: Yep will set up 30m. Closing thread  will post updates as rollout progresses.
